verdict.rationale: The docs homepage has a first-call guide with a ready example in both OpenAI and Anthropic API formats, including a note on switching to streaming. It also explains that you can call DeepSeek with the existing OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs just by changing configuration, which lowers onboarding friction. missing for 10: explicit evidence of code samples in multiple languages, documented API-key signup to first-call flow and timing, independent or hands-on confirmation that the quickstart works in minutes.
